description: One deploy stage: the bundle target names the object, and spec.subject is the exact CI subject (a GitHub Actions `sub`) allowed to deploy to that stage (#57). The operator renders one Keycloak client per object; Nova authorizes a deploy whose token was issued to that client.

spec.description: One deploy stage: the bundle target is the object's name and `spec.subject` is the exact CI subject allowed to deploy to it (#57).

audience.description: The audience the realm client's mapper puts in the token this stage accepts. Default `stardelt-deploy`.

environment.description: The GitHub `environment` the token was issued for, when the subject names one. Pinning an environment drops the `ref` part of the subject (#819), so the two are either/or.

subject.description: The exact CI subject as the identity provider receives it: `repo:<owner>/<name>:ref:refs/heads/<branch>` or `repo:<owner>/<name>:environment:<name>` (with GitHub's immutable ids: `repo:<owner>@<id>/<name>@<id>:ref:refs/heads/<branch>`).

title: DeployStage
